x: Of the four, Cotopaxi (Ecuador, ~5,897 m; Smithsonian lists 5,911 m) is the highest, just above Kilimanjaro (~5,895 m); Pinatubo (~1,486 m) and Taal ('Mount Tall', ~311 m) are low. (The world's highest volcano overall is Ojos del Salado, 6,893 m, not offered.)
source: NextGen Rocket World Geography p.2 (Ojos del Salado highest active volcano); app notes 4:8 sub 1; Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program (Cotopaxi 5,911 m listed; Kilimanjaro 5,895 m)
dispute: Most books and exam keys give Cotopaxi (often called the highest active volcano). Strictly, the highest volcano is Ojos del Salado (6,893 m, Chile–Argentina), which is not among the options.
